title: Hereditary local extension of one finite free stalk chain map
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $P,Q$ cochain complexes of $\mathcal O_Y$-modules [def-pc-derived-category], with $P$ supported in $[a,b]$ and $Q$ in $[c,e]$, where $a,b,c,e\in\mathbf Z$. Assume every term of each complex is either a zero object or isomorphic to a finite rank free sheaf [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. For $y\in Y$ let $T$ be termwise pullback along $Y.\mathrm{fromSpecStalk}(y)$ [def-pc-derived-pullback]. For one prescribed chain map $f:TP\to TQ$, there is an open $U$ containing $y$ such that for every open $V\subseteq U$ containing $y$, there exists a chain map $f_V:R_VP\to R_VQ$ whose pullback satisfies $S_V(f_V)=E_V(P).\mathrm{hom};f;E_V(Q).\mathrm{inv}$, with the canonical comparison $E_V$ of [def-pc-stalk-restriction-complex-iso]. No second map or homotopy identity is asserted.

proof.text: Apply the finite matrix extension theorem to obtain U, hyU and fU with the prescribed stalk equation.
Apply restriction stability to fU for every V ≤ U containing y.

theorem exists_restrict_chainMap_of_stalk_eventually
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (P Q : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℤ)
    (a b c e : ℤ)
    (hPa : P.IsStrictlyGE a) (hPb : P.IsStrictlyLE b)
    (hQc : Q.IsStrictlyGE c) (hQe : Q.IsStrictlyLE e)
    (hPfree : ∀ n : ℤ, IsZero (P.X n) ∨ ∃ s : ℕ, Nonempty
      (P.X n ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin s))))
    (hQfree : ∀ n : ℤ, IsZero (Q.X n) ∨ ∃ s : ℕ, Nonempty
      (Q.X n ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin s))))
    (y : Y)
    (f : ((Modules.pullback (Y.fromSpecStalk y)).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj P ⟶
      ((Modules.pullback (Y.fromSpecStalk y)).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj Q) :
    ∃ (U : Y.Opens), y ∈ U ∧ ∀ (V : Y.Opens) (hyV : y ∈ V), V ≤ U →
      let R := (restrictFunctor V.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
      let S := (Modules.pullback (V.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyV)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
      let eP := (stalkRestrictionComplexIso V y hyV).app P
      let eQ := (stalkRestrictionComplexIso V y hyV).app Q
      ∃ (fV : R.obj P ⟶ R.obj Q), S.map fV = eP.hom ≫ f ≫ eQ.inv
